output.summary: Read the GLOSS.grappled text and rulings R-05, R-06 and R-07, and ran one targeted engine mutation per test with `srdloop mutate`. Every mutation made its test fail. No oracle conflicts with the SRD text: ambiguous cases follow R-05 (Tiny-by-Tiny drag), R-06 (two grapplers) and R-07 (special Speeds), and difficult-terrain stacking is the uncontested natural reading. Exact duplicates: none. The closest overlaps are small_drags_small vs. same_size, Large→Medium vs. Medium→Small, and special_speed vs. the mid-turn climb assert. Each still pins a distinct boundary or code path, so I kept them at lower confidence. Verdict: keep all 30.
